**What the pages say**
- **Tiny Gym:** 
Cartwheels describes it as a child's first gym class, for its youngest gymnasts with a parent or caregiver.
 
Cartwheels strongly recommends that 1-year-olds be walking independently before the term begins.

- **Rock n' Roll:** 
The page describes a music and movement class for ages 0+, 45 minutes long.

- **Cartwheels registration:** 
The Cartwheels home page lists Term 1/Fall registration as Wednesday July 22, 2026, at 8:00am online for general programming.
 That date has already passed. I did not see Tiny Gym or Rock n' Roll days, times or prices on the pages I read. Cartwheels is at 12 Armstrong Ave., Georgetown, and its page lists info@cartwheelsgymcentre.com.
- **Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre:** This is a different gym on the same street. 
Its page lists a Fall 2026 session of 14 (13) weeks, September 12 to December 18, with registration opening July 20.
 
The class involves parent participation, with a structured warm-up, games, music and circuits.
 I did not see a day, time or price for it either.

All of this comes from each gym's own website. I have not confirmed anything with either gym directly.
